campus: Catania — Department of General Surgery and Medical-Surgical Specialties (CHIRMED)
admission_type: Restricted access at national level through the national English-language admission test (IMAT) and ranked selection.
admission_route: national_numerus_clausus_universitaly. Candidates register for the admission test and rank course/location preferences through Universitaly; applicants requiring a study visa must also complete the separate international pre-enrolment procedure on Universitaly.
citizenship_track: EU and EU-equated candidates (including the categories covered by Article 39(5) of Legislative Decree 286/1998) compete in the EU/equated ranking for 40 seats. Non-EU candidates residing abroad and requiring a visa compete in a separate reserved quota of 40 seats.
academic_requirements: An upper-secondary-school diploma is required. A foreign qualification is valid if awarded after at least 12 years of schooling and if it grants access to university and to the chosen programme in the country where it was awarded. Admission also requires placement within the relevant seat quota following the national English-language admission test.
eligible_bachelor_backgrounds: Not applicable: this is a first-entry, six-year single-cycle degree accessible with an eligible upper-secondary-school qualification; no bachelor's degree is required.
curricular_subject_prerequisites: No prior university-credit prerequisites are specified. The admission test assesses reading skills and knowledge acquired in prior studies, logical reasoning and problem solving, biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics.
degree_recency_limit: No recency limit is stated for the upper-secondary-school qualification.
undergraduate_in_progress_allowed: Not applicable. Applicants enter from upper-secondary education and must hold an eligible upper-secondary-school diploma.
language_requirements: Certified English proficiency at CEFR B2 is required for enrolment. The programme and admission test are in English.

english_certificate_thresholds.ielts_min: [uncertain] No IELTS score equivalence is specified in the UNICT 2026/27 call.
english_certificate_thresholds.toefl_ibt_min: [uncertain] No TOEFL iBT score equivalence is specified in the UNICT 2026/27 call.
english_certificate_thresholds.cambridge_min: [uncertain] No Cambridge certificate level is specified in the UNICT 2026/27 call; it states CEFR B2.

english_certificate_exemptions: [uncertain] The UNICT 2026/27 call requires certified CEFR B2 English for enrolment but does not state certificate exemptions.
italian_language_requirement: International students must attain and certify Italian at CEFR B2 by the third year. The latest programme teaching regulations located on the official site (2025/26) state that a compulsory 3-CFU Italian course is provided in year one.
application_deadline_eu: Admission-test registration through Universitaly: 9 September 2026 at 15:00 GMT+2 (registration opens 26 August 2026).
application_deadline_non_eu: For non-EU applicants residing abroad who require a visa: university pre-enrolment through Universitaly by 31 July 2026; admission-test registration through Universitaly by 9 September 2026 at 15:00 GMT+2 (registration opens 26 August 2026).
results_publication_date: Anonymous test scores: 8 October 2026; candidates may view their test paper, score and personal-data sheet on 19 October 2026; the named national merit ranking is published on 26 October 2026. The first ranking update is scheduled for 3 November 2026.
required_documents: For the Universitaly test registration, candidates provide personal and contact details, citizenship, tax code, residence information, identity-document type/number/issuer/validity, and any language certification held. A valid identity document is mandatory at the test, together with proof of fee payment. Holders of foreign school qualifications must provide the qualification and either a Declaration of Value issued by the competent Italian diplomatic mission or a CIMEA Statement of Comparability. Visa applicants must have submitted their international-student pre-enrolment through Universitaly. Disability/SLD accommodation requests require the relevant medical certification, conformity self-certification and identity document; foreign certificates must be legalised and accompanied by an official or sworn Italian/English translation.
entry_exam_or_test: National English-language admission test (IMAT) on 29 September 2026; check-in at 10:00, test begins at 13:30, duration 100 minutes. It consists of 60 five-option multiple-choice questions: 4 reading/general-study knowledge, 5 logical reasoning/problems, 23 biology, 15 chemistry, and 13 physics/mathematics. Scoring is +1.5 correct, -0.4 incorrect, 0 unanswered. EU/equated candidates require at least 20 points; non-EU candidates residing abroad require a score above zero and compete in their reserved ranking.
credential_recognition_documents: A foreign upper-secondary qualification must represent at least 12 years of schooling and grant access to university and the chosen programme in the awarding country. It must be accompanied by either a Declaration of Value from the competent Italian diplomatic mission or a CIMEA Statement of Comparability.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://www.unict.it/it/didattica/tasse-ed-esoneri (official 2026/27 tuition and exemptions page). The admission call states a EUR 156 fixed amount at enrolment and an annual comprehensive contribution of EUR 150 for students not resident in Italy.
application_fee: [uncertain] A test-participation fee is mandatory and non-payment prevents participation, but the UNICT call does not state the amount; it says payment instructions will be published on Universitaly when registration opens.
enrolment_confirmation_fee: Assigned candidates must submit the enrolment application and pay a EUR 156 fixed amount through UNICT Smart_Edu within the applicable four-day ranking window. The EUR 156 comprises EUR 140 regional right-to-study tax and EUR 16 virtual stamp duty. Students not resident in Italy also have an annual comprehensive contribution of EUR 150.
places_quota_non_eu: 40 seats reserved for non-EU candidates residing abroad.
places_quota_total: 80 seats total: 40 for EU/equated candidates and 40 for non-EU candidates residing abroad.
application_portal_url: https://www.universitaly.it/it (admission-test registration and international pre-enrolment); after assignment, UNICT enrolment is completed at https://studenti.smartedu.unict.it/.
governing_decree_reference: D.R. 2882 of 10 August 2026; the procedure implements Ministerial Decree No. 1005 of 6 August 2026 and its annexes.

uncertainty_notes: The 2026/27 UNICT call is current and governs the main admission facts. The exact test-participation fee and accepted B2 certificate equivalences/exemptions are not stated in the UNICT call because payment details are delegated to Universitaly and the certificate list is not reproduced. The Italian B2-by-year-three rule is supported by the latest programme teaching regulation located on the official site (2025/26), not a 2026/27 regulation. The programme page identifies the revised degree class as LM-41 R, whereas the admission call table abbreviates it to LM-41.
